title: Ben van Kerkwijk on the Hawara labyrinth and ancient accounts

tellings.quote: What do you think of you know Ben van Kerkwijk? He just went on Joe Rogan's show and he talks about this large labyrinth The huge labyrinth like Hawara region and

plain: A huge labyrinth once stood at Hawara in Egypt, a claim Michels raises by pointing to a man named Ben van Kerkwijk, who had just talked about it on the show of the podcaster Joe Rogan. The account draws on the ancient writers Herodotus, the Greek historian, and Pliny the Elder, the Roman author. Michels puts it as a question to a scientist who scanned beneath the pyramids and gives no more detail.
